query.description: Customer Address (Required if lat, long not provided)
Add Customer code if you make new customer or you enter the route id.
Add address Id if you make new customer
Payee possible values are S,R (Required) S means sender will pay and R means Receiver will pay
is same day delivery possible values are 1,0 (Required)
is free of charge possible values are 1,0 (Required)
Order Deliver DateTime Format will be 2020-06-24 (Required)
Order Deliver Time From Format will be hh:mm (24 hours)
Order Deliver Time To Format will be hh:mm (24 hours)
Order Deliver Time From Format will be UTC
Order Deliver Time To Format will be UTC
Order Pickup Date Time From Format will be 2021-12-25 hh:mm (24 hours)
Order Pickup Date Time To Format will be 2021-12-25 hh:mm (24 hours)
Use Payment term api to get payment term id.
Use routes api to get route id.
is Update possible values are 1,0. If value is 1 then tracking_no will be mandatory
Product Items in JSON format. Required format: [{"externalProductCode":"xxx","qty":2,"unitPrice":10}] or [{"product_name":"xxx","qty":2,"product_base_price":10,"product_tax":5}]

Customer Type:
        1 = Individual Customer,
        2 = Corporate Customer,
        3 = Watchman,
        4 = Supermarket,
        5 = Abraaj FOC,
        6 = Co-Packing,
        7 = Co-operatives,
        9 = E-commerce,
        10 = Horeca,
        12 = Mabara,
        13 = Modern Trade,
        14 = Mosques,
        15 = Staff account
